subject.title: Gateway crash: ERR_INVALID_STATE — FileHandle closed during GC (active-memory plugin session.jsonl.lock)

question: Should the team first require a targeted Node 26 or forced-GC reproduction for the active-memory temporary session-lock path before accepting a shared fs-safe or gateway-lock repair as its fix?
rationale: The reported crash is credible, but the unmerged candidate repair demonstrates a different inbound-media path and does not prove the lock path is covered.

options.title: Prove the active-memory path first
options.body: Capture a redacted Node 26 or forced-GC run that associates the temporary `session.jsonl.lock` FileHandle with its concrete owner before choosing the repair boundary.

options.title: Adopt the shared fs-safe repair with explicit scope acceptance
options.body: Accept the dependency-level repair only after maintainers explicitly confirm it covers the active-memory lock lifecycle and its packaging metadata and proof are complete.

recommendation.title: Prove the active-memory path first
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted Node 26 or forced-GC run that associates the temporary `session.jsonl.lock` FileHandle with its concrete owner before choosing the repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The related candidate fix and the fs-safe dependency history point to this filesystem-lifecycle boundary.
